page.overview:
Who is Alec?

Alec was a Human male smuggler fence who operated near the Research Outpost on the Forest Moon of Endor during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Alec was a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, Alec was added to the game along with the smuggling missions introduced with the "Chapter 3" update, released on September 27, 2006.
